test_NDCGridRaysampler: test the NDCGridRaysampler to sample rays in normalized device coordinates for a given camera
test_MonteCarloRaysampler: test the MonteCarloRaysampler to randomly sample rays across an image for a batch of cameras
test_MultinomialRaysampler: test the MultinomialRaysampler to sample rays on a grid using multinomial distribution for cameras
test_jiggle_within_stratas: test the _jiggle_within_stratas function to add stratified jitter to ascending tensor values
test_safe_multinomial: test the _safe_multinomial function to sample indices from a masked probability tensor
